articles.title: Halftone Print
articles.summary: Regular halftone dot grid, radius varies with tonal map; metallic R channel gives pop-art comic shimmer. Reads as a smooth sheen with a very fine screened dot texture, like newsprint up close; no pop-art dot art shows from distance.
articles.what: Regular halftone grid with per-cell radius modulated by FBM tonal map — pop-art / comic halftone dots, R=Metallic Up close: A regular dot grid at roughly 12 px pitch, with very small soft dots that vary slightly in size from place to place. On satin the highlight shows a dotty screen; on metal it is only a faint dot lattice in the band and clear dark dots in the shadow zone. From a distance: Reads as a smooth sheen with a very fine screened dot texture, like newsprint up close; no pop-art dot art shows from distance. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: the channels set by its defaults. Group: Artistic & Abstract (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: medium.
when: Best on: body, hood, hero panel.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Artistic & Abstract", or search for "Halftone Print".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof, doors: dots read on open panels
Numbers keep their colour; the faint dot grid does not hurt legibility.
Soft dotted screen in the highlight; gentle print-like satin
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, satin.
pitfalls: Not a printed halftone graphic: it adds no colour, only shine dots
Not hammered dimples: dots are tiny and flat-regular, not cupped
Avoid: too fine for small decals, may clash with busy liveries.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Halftone Print over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
